answer: Each identity earns standing by salvaging driftwood from the ocean of unfinished tasks: it must complete an abandoned job and have the original owner sign the result, chaining each salvage to the last in a mirror ledger any peer can re-check. A sybil operator cannot fake this, because every link demands real work on a real abandoned task plus a genuine owner's signature, and the chain grows only one link per epoch. Random sparrow calls add live proof: at random moments the agent must answer within minutes, naming its latest salvage, so a fleet of dormant puppets cannot keep pace.
